A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''crime lord''' was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and he commissioned a [[Unidentified priceless bangle|priceless bangle]] from a [[Unidentified jeweler|jeweler]] for his [[Unidentified crime lord's daughter|daughter's]] [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]]. When a [[Unidentified jewel thief|jewel thief]] stole the bangle without knowing who it was for, an independent individual negotiated a deal where the crime lord bought the bangle for a fraction of the jeweler's price.<ref name="Too Hot to Handle" />
